title.en: An Act Declaring December Eighteen of Every Year as "Araw Ng Laguna" and a Special Working Day in the Province of Laguna and the City of San Pablo to Commemorate the Memory and Death of the Late Governor Felicisimo T. San Luis

text.en: Governor Felicisimo T. San Luis was regarded as the father of the agro-industrial development of Laguna. He pioneered the promotion of family planning; increased rice production variety in cooperation with the International Rice Research Institute (IRRI); worked for the establishment of hundreds of industries in the first and second districts of the province; and sustained economic and improved infrastructures in Laguna.

December eighteen of every year is hereby declared as "Araw ng Laguna" and a special working day in the Province of Laguna and the City of San Pablo to commemorate the memory and death of the late Governor Felicisimo T. San Luis.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
